1995
Built on engineering excellence.

Ir. Tiew Soon Aik founded IAQ in Malaysia in 1995, as a cleanroom specialist. Today it builds in seven countries.

The record since 1995
“
None of this would have been possible without the incredible dedication and hard work of our remarkable team.
Ir. Tiew Soon Aik
Founder and Chief Executive Officer, January 2024
Read the story
Six values, on the record.

The values are IAQ’s own words. Beside each one is where the record already shows it.

1
Safety commitment
An injury free workplace where everybody goes home safe.
2.6 million safe manhours on the East Malaysia wafer fab expansion.
ISO
9001
2
Quality consistency
The skills to bring excellence to your project, managed through an established QMS.
ISO 9001:2015 quality management, certified by Intertek and audited.
3
Honesty and integrity
Transparent communication of accurate information, with openness and sincerity in every interaction.
A written Whistleblowing Policy, published beside the Quality and Environment, Health and Safety policies.
4
Engineering capabilities
An experienced multi-disciplinary in-house team, integrating technology and value engineering for advanced hi-tech facilities.
An ISO Class 1 cleanroom, the highest class IAQ has built, delivered for a semiconductor client.
5
Efficiency and proficiency
Flexible fast-track execution and contractual approaches, fitted to the client’s needs.
A green certified plant delivered ahead of schedule, through the pandemic.
6
Pursuit of excellence
Delivering on our commitments with the highest degree of engineering excellence.
Builder of the Year at the 2024 Malaysian Construction Industry Excellence Awards, by CIDB.
Everybody goes home safe.

Why build your career at IAQ.
Engineering & Construction Profession

Build your career in the engineering and construction industry, working on diverse and challenging projects.

Career and Professional Growth

Opportunities for career development, training and professional certificates such as PMP, PE and more.

Global Opportunities

Gain international exposures and opportunities to work across different countries, markets and cultures.

People and Cultures

Be part of a vibrant and inclusive workplace where we celebrate together, give back through CSR and create meaningful connections across global offices.

Engineering and facility solutions since 1995.
